tracks.title: The Stardust Engine
tracks.loreNote: Opens *Hard Reset Live* with Part I of **The Stardust Suite**, immediately righting the greatest wrong of 1990's *Live in Chicago*: Cassidy's analog synthesizer leitmotif is pushed right to the front of the arena PA alongside Ryan's overdriven electric guitar from his wheelchair at center stage.

tracks.title: Hard Reset
tracks.loreNote: Transitioning seamlessly into Part II of **The Stardust Suite**, the band wipes the Apex Records slate clean in front of 18,000 screaming fans.

tracks.title: Brand New Scene
tracks.loreNote: Completes the opening three-part **Stardust Suite** (*"We are the cosmos! We are the fire!"*), celebrating the family's first headlining arena tour as independent owners of *Engine Room Records, LLC*.

tracks.title: Static
tracks.loreNote: Originally dubbed onto mail-order cassettes inside their freezing warehouse studio in 1995, *"I am the static! I am the noise!"* becomes a deafening 18,000-voice arena chant.

tracks.title: Not Your Doll
tracks.loreNote: Cassidy's fierce 1989 rebellion against the corporate pop-idol box, finally unleashed live with the full heavy rock teeth Apex suppressed.

tracks.title: The Fortress
tracks.loreNote: Dedicated nightly from the stage to the grassroots Ironheads and Forger Nation fans who funded the band's survival during the 1992–1995 Wilderness Years.

tracks.title: No Hidden Gravity
tracks.loreNote: The booming 1996 *Ad Astra* B-side power ballad celebrating pure platonic and safe-person devotion, sung by Ryan and Cassidy as a direct refutation of forced industry tropes.

tracks.title: Thunderhead
tracks.loreNote: Kicks off the second half of the concert with slow-stomping, heavy arena thunder (*"You muted the kick / You silenced the crash"*).

tracks.title: Redline
tracks.loreNote: Segues directly out of *"Thunderhead"* with the governors torn off—featuring an extended live duel between Ryan's electric guitar and Cassidy's synthesizer.

tracks.title: Moon 1: Tidal Lock
tracks.loreNote: The arena lights dim to a deep planetarium starfield as Cassidy debuts the live iteration of **The Cosmic Tidal Lock Sound™**, bathing the crowd in zero-gravity analog synth pads.

tracks.title: Echoes in the Wire
tracks.loreNote: **The Emotional Heart of the Show.** Standing in the exact setlist slot where Apex once forced Cassidy to sing the permanently banned *"If You Walked Away"*, Ryan rolls his chair right beside Cassidy's keyboard riser to sing *"Echoes in the Wire"* shoulder-to-shoulder.

tracks.title: Electric Color
tracks.loreNote: The mandatory concert closer—performed 10 BPM faster with roaring guitars, soaring analog synths, and total independence.
